111999.overview: Idaho Jones broadcasts an announcement about the Interstellar Wrestling League to summon all wrestlers across the galaxy in a tournament that will determine who among them tops them all. There are four modes in the game including Tour Mode, Single Player Game, Two Player Game and Training Mode. To select a wrestler, the player needs to scan a character card. Each wrestler has their own Strength, Stamina, Jump, Fortitude and Luck stats, which can be improved with attributes points. The player has the option to choose an opponent and planet to fight. In the fighting ring, opponents use different kicks, punches, throws and special moves. Each fighting round last 1 minute and 45 seconds. Successfully beating opponents earns attributes points to upgrade the chosen fighter.
